This [[Gender|male]] [[human]]<ref name="Episode IV" /> '''[[Imperial Navy Trooper]]''' was present in [[Cell 2187]] during [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] [[Torture|interrogation]] at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. Later he accompanied Organa and Vader to the [[Overbridge (Death Star I)|Overbridge]] and witnessed the [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction of]] [[Alderaan]]. After coming to the realization that Organa had lied about the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Dantooine base|base]] being on [[Dantooine]] and realizing that he wouldn't betray Organa to Vader or [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], the [[trooper]] came to recognize that his loyalty had changed and that he had joined her Rebellion.<ref name="Change of Heart" /> Not too long after, the [[Death Star]] was destroyed during the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Episode IV" />
